runs.question: Search the knowledge base: what do elevated liver enzymes mean?
runs.answer: Elevated liver enzymes typically indicate inflammation or damage to liver cells, which causes enzymes like alanine transaminase (ALT) and aspartate transaminase (AST) to leak into the bloodstream [KB]. Common causes include fatty liver disease, certain medications (such as statins), infections, trauma, or other conditions affecting the liver [KB]. Mild elevations are often found during routine blood tests, even in asymptomatic individuals [KB]. A healthcare provider usually evaluates the underlying cause by reviewing symptoms, medications, and additional tests [KB].
